wsjHeadlines.description: The 96-year-old, whose son Howard succeeds him as chairman, will remain on the board.

wsjHeadlines.description: Plus: A-CAP insurers sue South Carolina regulator over takeover attempt.

wsjHeadlines.title: How to Tell Whether a Plunging Stock Will Keep Plunging
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, the yen slides again

wsjHeadlines.title: Meta’s AI Agent Has a Trust Problem
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s Muse AI agent needs user data to be useful, but users might be wary.

wsjHeadlines.title: Christine Lagarde Helped Block Binance’s Foothold in Europe
wsjHeadlines.description: The ECB chief intervened to keep crypto’s biggest player, which pleaded guilty to financial-crime violations in the U.S., from operating in the EU.

wsjHeadlines.title: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Post Biggest Gains in Six Weeks
wsjHeadlines.description: Traders turned their attention away from inflation and interest rates toward tech stocks. And record donations are flowing into state attorneys general races.

wsjHeadlines.title: Saudi Arabia Has Another Option to Get Its Oil Out
wsjHeadlines.description: A shuttle service that slips oil through the Strait of Hormuz now looks like the kingdom’s best fallback.

wsjHeadlines.title: Trump Administration Shift Puts This Corner of Biotech Back in Favor
wsjHeadlines.description: With the Food and Drug Administration’s hard-liners gone, investors are rushing back into rare-disease bets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bond Yields Could Come Down as Fast as They’ve Climbed
wsjHeadlines.description: Expectations for what the Fed will do are driving the recent moves in long-term yields.

wsjHeadlines.title: Why Mortgage Bonds Are at Risk if Rates Rise—and if They Fall
wsjHeadlines.description: There are fewer people sitting on ultracheap mortgages than you might think.

wsjHeadlines.title: Heart Disease, a Historic Strength for Big Pharma, Becomes a Weakness
wsjHeadlines.description: Heart disease remains humanity’s top killer, yet for drugmakers and Wall Street, it is becoming one of the hardest places to make money.

wsjHeadlines.title: Ant International-Backed Fintech Unicorn Gets Nod for Philippines’s Largest-Ever IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: Mynt is entering the IPO market amid heightened uncertainty in global markets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Wells Fargo, Australian banks and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Truist to Sell $5.5 Billion of Loans as It Exits Near-Prime Auto Lending
wsjHeadlines.description: Truist Financial has inked a deal to sell $5.5 billion of auto loans as part of the regional bank’s decision to exit the near-prime auto lending business.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Sanctions Russian Bank in Latest Target for Campaign Against Iran
wsjHeadlines.description: The Treasury put additional sanctions on Russia’s VTB Bank, in a bid to pressure foreign banks to cut ties with the institution.

wsjHeadlines.title: How PayPal’s CEO Is Planning to Go It Alone and Fix the Payments Giant
wsjHeadlines.description: A $50 billion buyout is stalled but Enrique Lores could make a $25 million bonus if Wall Street buys into his plans to transform the payments company.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank of Japan Raises Rates, Making U.S. Less Alluring for Tokyo Investors
wsjHeadlines.description: The yen weakened as two members of the bank’s board suggested future rate rises might come more slowly than anticipated.

wsjHeadlines.title: Eurozone Government Bond Yields Edge Higher But Stay Below Recent Highs
wsjHeadlines.description: Yields on eurozone government bonds edged higher but stayed comfortably below recent multiyear highs, helped by falling oil prices and lower Treasury yields.

wsjHeadlines.title: Energy & Utilities Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on oil, Drax, European gas prices and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on precious metals futures, Wacker Chemie, Carnaby and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on U.S. pending home sales, Emirates NBD, the Federal Reserve and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. AI-Related Stocks Extend Rally Premarket
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks linked to the build-out in artificial intelligence continued to rally premarket. Intel rose 2.3%, Sandisk and Micron Technology rose 1.6% and 1.1% respectively.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Futures Rise as Oil Extends Losses, Treasury Yields Rise
wsjHeadlines.description: All major U.S. indexes were in the green after the S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted their best trading days in six weeks during the prior session.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Come Back to AI Stocks, Snapping Market Out of Inflation Gloom
wsjHeadlines.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite posted their biggest one-day gains in six weeks.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Up on Hopes Rising Inflation, Oil Prices Are Now Contained
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks recouped some of their recent losses as oil prices stabilized and confidence grew in the Federal Reserve’s ability to contain inflation.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Rally, Shaking Off Fed’s Rate Hike
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, chip shares soar on Intel comments and SEC clears path for trading tokenized stocks

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The SEC’s Big and Welcome Proxy Reform
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency wants to stop telling companies how to handle shareholder resolutions.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Development Banks Have Misplaced Priorities
wsjHeadlines.description: Climate investments pull resources away from fighting poverty.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Bring Back State-Led Corporate Governance
wsjHeadlines.description: Reducing federal oversight will allow states to set rules that focus on business value over politicized initiatives.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Flawed Model That Burdens Small Banks
wsjHeadlines.description: The current expected credit losses accounting standard forces banks to predict future economic outcomes and drains resources.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Treasury’s Bond Strategy Hurts Taxpayers
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency’s justification for doubling its long-term bond purchases is flawed.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Don’t Tax the Unicorns
wsjHeadlines.description: New research shows how much tax policy matters to innovation.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Rises Amid Easing Yields, Oil Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold prices rose above the $4,400-an-ounce mark, supported by lower Treasury yields and easing oil prices.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Extends Losses on Saudi Supply Hopes
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices extended losses from the previous session, with Brent crude now around $102 a barrel amid efforts to restore Saudi export capacity.

wsjHeadlines.title: Crude Oil Futures Settle Lower For Second Session
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude futures fell as the supply fears fueled by the outage of Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline eased, and oil continued to make it through the Strait of Hormuz via ship-to-ship loadings and dark transits.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Inch Down in Choppy Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures ended a choppy session little changed with some support from a below-average weekly storage build that trimmed the inventory surplus.

wsjHeadlines.title: Crude Oil Futures Post Back-to Back Losses
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices fell amid expectations that Saudi Arabia could soon restore some oil flows through its damaged East-West pipeline while shipping crude through the Strait of Hormuz.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Rises to 7-Week High on U.S. Rate Hike Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: The DXY dollar index rose as high as 100.448—a seven-week high against a basket of currencies—as markets bet on further U.S. interest rate rises.

wsjHeadlines.title: Failure of Clarity Act Turns Crypto Industry Focus to Federal Regulators
wsjHeadlines.description: EXCLUSIVE: The act’s failure to progress leaves regulation of the cryptocurrency industry in the hands of government agencies and vulnerable to interpretation as administrations change, analysts said.
